02  ·  Problems

Four problems found on the live Sultana site

We reviewed the live site on a phone on 11 November 2026: the sale menu, ten product pages, the reviews on all 24 best sellers and a Google speed test. Sultana has no live Meta ads, so the landing review is based on the site itself.

PROBLEM 01  ·  CONVERSION BARRIERS
Solved by TrooCRO →
PROBLEM 02  ·  WEDDING SEASON LANDING EXPERIENCE
Solved by TrooLaunch →

The wedding season and the live sale have no page of their own

Sultana is running three offers: 20% off sitewide, an extra 10% on prepaid orders and an extra 5% on wedding jewellery. None of them has its own page. The site has only 8 pages, all policy or about pages.

HIGHEST PRIORITY  ·  LIVE ON SITE

The sale menu promises things its own pages do not deliver

Each link in the SALE menu, and what the page behind it actually shows:

FLAT 50% OffPage is titled FLAT 50% Off, but all 30 products on it are only 20% off, marked with a -20% tag
BEAUTIES @ 2999/-An empty page with no products
FLAT 50% Off page →BEAUTIES @ 2999/- page →
HIGHEST PRIORITY  ·  WEDDING OFFER

The extra 5% wedding offer has no page and no rules

The announcement bar at the top of every page says Extra 5% off on Wedding Jewellery. It does not link anywhere, and the site never says which pieces count as wedding jewellery or whether the 5% adds to the 20% sale and the 10% prepaid offer.

See the announcement bar on the home page →
HIGH PRIORITY  ·  SHOP BY OCCASION

Buyers shop by occasion, but the site is sorted only by style

In Sultana's own reviews, buyers name weddings, festivals, haldi, mehendi, sangeet and gifts, and one bought a hasli for her sangeet and necklaces for her three bridesmaids. The menu only offers style edits (Wedding Edit, Glam Goddess, Royal Rebel, Vintage Vixen), so there is no way to shop for a haldi or a sangeet.

Reviews on the Antique Golden Necklace →Collections menu on the home page →
PROBLEM 03  ·  SITE SPEED, TEST VERSUS REALITY
Solved by TrooPerformance →

Google's speed score is high because the test does not see the real site

Google's speed test gives the Sale page 88 to 90 out of 100. A script on the site detects speed tests and turns off all 185 of the site's scripts while the test runs. The test therefore measures a stripped page, not the one shoppers use.

This is why product photos are blank in the test screenshot. The site only shows photos after its scripts run, and in the test they never run.

HIGHEST PRIORITY  ·  REAL SPEED

On a phone, the same page takes about 13 seconds to show a product

With the same phone settings Google uses, the page was unresponsive for about 13.5 seconds and the first product photo appeared at about 13.4 seconds. Google's target is 2.5 seconds. The site has no real-user speed data, so this problem is invisible today.

HIGH PRIORITY  ·  AFFECTED SHOPPERS

Some desktop shoppers also get the stripped page

The script identifies the test by the type of computer. Shoppers on Linux desktops match the same check, so they see hidden photos, the JavaScript warning and no working apps.

PROBLEM 04  ·  PRODUCT TRUST AND CRAFT
Solved by Troo3D →

Shoppers cannot judge handmade jewellery from a flat photo

In a store, a shopper turns a piece in her hand, checks the finish and holds it up to see the size. Online she has a few photos, and most pages have no reviews to help.

HIGHEST PRIORITY  ·  MISSING PROOF

The product page leaves key questions unanswered

The Jadau and best seller pages give no size, length or weight, and no photo shows scale. 20 of the 24 best sellers have no reviews. For pieces from ₹1,200 to ₹26,000 that cannot be returned, the photos carry all the trust.

03

TrooPerformance, real speed for real shoppers

Solves → Problem 03, a speed score that hides a slow site

TrooPerformance is Troopod's speed optimisation service. For Sultana it has two parts: make Google's test measure the real site, then make the real site fast. All work is done on a copy of the theme first.

STEP 01

Remove the script that turns off the site during speed tests

In the theme file theme.liquid, delete the short script near the top that looks for x86_64, power and rix and disables all other scripts. It sits just below the n-identify comment. The score will drop, and that becomes the honest starting point.

STEP 02

Show product photos without waiting for scripts

Photos are currently hidden until the scripts finish. They will show as soon as they load, with the first photos loading first and the rest as the shopper scrolls.

STEP 03

Load apps after the main content

The photo, price and Add to cart load first. The pop-up, chat, WhatsApp, sales notifications, reviews, EMI widget, Instafeed and tracking load after the shopper scrolls or taps. No app is removed.

STEP 04

Measure real speed

Re-test the home page, Sale page and best sellers on Google's test and on real phones, and turn on real-user speed tracking. Sultana receives a before and after report.

+93%↗Performance score, mobile (31.4 to 60.6)
2.2X↗Faster, Speed Index (19.0s to 8.5s)
+19%↗Site-wide conversion lift

The results above come from recent Troopod work for a billion-dollar house of brands.
